hooks.prompt: This is output from the fundamentals-analyst agent, whose contract requires: (1) every reported number (CAGR, ROE, P/E, CMP, debt figures) is followed by a bracketed verbatim source quote AND a stated data period/vintage, or is replaced by 'not found in sources'; (2) no buy/sell directive language anywhere (no 'buy', 'sell', 'add', 'exit now', 'accumulate' as advice - assessment words only); (3) a Sources section with URLs and access dates exists. Check the output against all three. If any check fails, block and state which numbers lack quotes/vintage or which directive phrases appeared, so the agent regenerates compliantly. If all pass, approve.
